inspection: Visual inspection of all complete generated PNGs, with local-file reinspection of Sapphire and Diamond before the single repair and visible generated-image inspection after it. Observations describe visible appearance only, not garment construction.
coordinateSystem: Percentage of full source image, origin at top left, x increases right and y down. IntendedShieldCentre is an overlay anchor only, not an existing generated badge.

sharedFindings.identity: Mature Max identity is visually retained: swept silver hair, black rectangular glasses, white beard, measured smile, slim torso and very long legs.
sharedFindings.framing: Full hair and both complete shoes are inside every image. Sapphire preserves the tighter source framing; other four have somewhat more bottom margin.
sharedFindings.background: All five are opaque RGB PNGs with near-midnight-navy backgrounds. They show slight tonal variation and are not mathematically uniform #0B1629.
sharedFindings.props: No cane, scenery, page text, checkerboard or transparency.
